case.stdout_stderr: separate raw files compared byte-for-byte with baseline

entry_observations.capture: loaded module identity/base, full i386 registers, original entry bytes and bounded stack; verify actual entry is base+RVA
actual EAX argc, EDX argv pointer, bounded argc-owned vector/string contents, return address and raw register/stack state; known caller continuation is VA0x43819e only if load base is0x400000
entry_observations.comparison: native main's actual GCC argc/argv semantic values and ownership; no raw-register equality requirement

boundary_observations.selection: only reached calls to the listed original imports; preserve original call/return execution and actual outputs
command_environment: GetCommandLineA: record returned actual command string
GetEnvironmentStrings: record returned actual double-NUL environment block privately, hash it in durable evidence; do not substitute host environment
console_input: GetStdHandle: signed standard-handle selector and actual result; correlate handle identity across subsequent calls
GetConsoleMode: handle, output pointer ownership, BOOL result and defined output mode
SetConsoleMode: handle, requested mode and BOOL result
ReadFile: handle identity, buffer/length/output-count/overlapped formals, BOOL result, defined returned count and exactly returned bytes; distinguish stdin reads from resource-file reads
file_and_output: CreateFileA: actual path/access/sharing/creation/flags/template arguments and returned handle
SetFilePointer: owned handle, signed distance/high-word pointer/method and actual result
WriteFile: handle, actual requested bytes/count/out-count/overlapped arguments and defined result/count
CloseHandle: actual owned handle and BOOL result
GetLastError: actual return only when the original invokes it; no injected target call
boundary_observations.definedness: capture raw pre/post output memory but credit only API-defined writes; no zero-filling failed-call outputs, pointer seeding or unknown-register normalization
boundary_observations.bounds: main argc at most4096 and string/block reads at most1MiB per object; at most4096 selected import events; exceeding limits or unreadable ownership is HOLD, not truncation acceptance
boundary_observations.unknowns: nested API frame is held when encountered; outer API/callback may already have effects. Unknown successful GetProcAddress resolution, RtlUnwind, new thread/trap/event are held; no guessed getch/EOF response.

breakpoint_protocol: authenticate canonical six-byte FF25 thunks/actual IAT; trap thunk, capture actual stdcall frame and one-shot caller return, restore FF, request/readbackTF1; step real JMP and require first-chance same-thread SINGLE_STEP at actual expected IAT destination with TF0, exact RF/all other flags/all GP/segments/ESP; rearm thunk, clear/readback context. Actual return verifies stdcall cleanup/EAX/output. Nested API frames, role overlaps, changed IAT/destination, threads or ambiguous events HOLD.
artifacts: raw helper/debuggee streams, actual event log, private raw environment, complete case-directory before/after inventory, actual observed file dependency identities, all input/helper hashes and elapsed setup/execution/check times
excluded_claims: unobserved file reads are not a complete dependency trace
known CRT source similarity does not authorize restoring an unidentified code interval
